name: Holy Toledo Winter 2014

venue.name: Ottawa Hills High School
venue.details: Through the main door facing Osborn St and up the stairs, follow the signs.

information: Registration is $15 if you pre-register.  On-site registration is allowed; however, it will cost $20 and you will not be able to compete in FMC, MultiBLD, 3x3x3 With Feet, or 6x6x6.  The FMC and MultiBLD attempts will happen simultaneously, so you must choose only one of these two events.  Skewb is a tentative event, and will be added if time permits.
